title: False projection chart-pasting prefix
statement: For the fixed false projection, the intermediate comparison followed by projection exchange, ordinary projective-line exchange, and shifted-line pushforward equals the intermediate comparison followed by the diagonal chart map [lem-sf-p1-chart-exchange].
